title: Answer questions of externally run relays from ork (needs slicer relay-run ask and answer)

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Owner 2026-10-25. Relays run by an outer Claude session (started elsewhere) have no channel from ork back to the orchestrator. The owner wants a mailbox. adj 161 (relay.answer-channel) recommends slicer relay-run ask and relay-run answer in the shared ledger (ork uses slicer only through its CLI, goal C03; ork cannot write ../slicer). Draft slicer item: .scratch/slicer-relay-ask.md (the owner files it). This slice waits for slicer to ship it and for a relay contract version that tells an orchestrator to ask and poll; then ork adds that version to its accepted set.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestRelayAnswerPassesOptionOrTextAndBy` (`internal/slicercli/write_test.go`, fake slicer): argv is `relay-run answer RUN QID --option LABEL --by NAME --json`, or `--text TEXT --by NAME`; no `--why`; the engine's own call (`engine.go` about :455) still passes its text.
- `TestDaemonRelayAnswerRefuses` (`internal/daemon/relayanswer_test.go`): unknown project, an ended run, an unknown or already answered question, an option the question does not offer, an empty `By`, and a run linked to an engine run (answered through the engine) are refused with no slicer write.
- `TestDaemonRelayAnswerAlsoAnswersAKeyedOpenAdjRecord`: a question with `key` that `adj check` reports open as #N answers the ledger first, then adj #N with the same option (or text), `Via` `tui`; a decided, closed or missing key answers the ledger only and the result message says why adj was skipped; a project without adj answers the ledger only; an adj failure after the ledger write returns the ledger success and names the adj error in the message.
- `TestExternalQuestionNumberKeyConfirmsThenAnswers` (`internal/tui/relayanswer_test.go`): a live external run with a blocker question; `2` opens a confirm that names the run, `#QID (Title)` and the option (marked `(recommended)` when it is); `n`, `enter` and `esc` send nothing; `y` sends once with the exact params (`Via` `tui`, `By` from `ADJ_DECIDED_BY`); the confirm also says `and adj #N` when the key is open.
- `TestExternalNonBlockerQuestionIsAnswerable`: an unanswered question on a running (not waiting) step of a live run shows in the pane with the answer keys.
- `TestStaleOrLinkedRunQuestionStaysReadOnly`: a stale run keeps only `x end run`; a linked engine run keeps its engine answer path; neither offers the new keys.
- `TestExternalAnswerFreeTextPendingAndMissingBy`: `t` opens the field, `enter review` only for non-empty text, a second key while in flight says pending, an unset `ADJ_DECIDED_BY` refuses with no call, a refusal shows verbatim.
- Goldens `testdata/golden/ledger-answer-confirm-100x30-{color,mono}.txt`.
